▽ More
Drug
discovery
requires continuous
scientific
decision-making across a vast research space. We introduce PharmAgents2, an
autonomous
system for end-to-end drug
discovery
that combines knowledge-enhanced decision-making with organized large-scale exploration. Paper2Skill extracts transferable
scientific
decision knowledge from public sources and, together with expert-developed skills, supports research decisions. Self-Scaling
Discovery
expands exploration through parallel
agents
inheriting research context and decision-making capabilities across targets,
scientific
hypotheses, and
discovery
strategies. We introduce PharmAgents-Bench v0.1, comprising 121 questions across nine decision scenarios and three end-to-end tasks assessed with expert-defined process rubrics. PharmAgents2 outperforms evaluated baselines in most decision categories and achieves the highest process scores on all three end-to-end tasks. In three real-world studies,
autonomous
investigations generated findings subsequently supported by human-executed experiments. For LpxH, PharmAgents2 hypothesized a previously unreported allosteric site and screened compounds against it, identifying a novel inhibitor scaffold with experimentally confirmed inhibitory activity and binding.
